facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance published its Digital Transformation Roadmap 2023/2024-2027/2028 as the means to deliver the Digital Uganda Vision, with cabinet in the governance chart; the document names no adopting act and speaks of 'the approval of the Roadmap', and the as-of is its published date, 2023-01-01.
The Roadmap's text is published as a PDF on the Ministry of ICT and National Guidance's site (ict.go.ug); the as-of is its published date, 2023-01-01.
The Roadmap's title and its five-year plan give its period as 2023/2024 to 2027/2028; the as-of is its published date, 2023-01-01.

The Roadmap carries a five-year initiative plan with lead entities and years, and Annex 1 gives a proposed budget in US dollars for each short, medium and long-term project; the as-of is its published date, 2023-01-01.

The Roadmap assigns governance to the Digital Transformation Program Working Group, 'now in place', with technical working groups and a Digital Transformation Office at the Ministry, reporting to cabinet; the as-of is its published date, 2023-01-01.
